request.lesson: A shipped-instruction check keyed on a fixed N-line window around a statement is satisfiable by adding lines rather than by fixing the defect. Two explanatory comment lines pushed a statement's governing transition out of a six-line window, turning a flagging check green while the property went unverified. Key such a check on an enclosing structural boundary such as a fenced block, and assert a non-vacuity floor naming how many sites must have been examined.

A plan that specifies more test mechanism than an implementer needs generates its own review findings. Across five spec-stage review rounds on install-to-ship-walkthrough the counts fell 26, 10, 8, 4, 1, but 6 of the 10 in round 2 and 6 of the 8 in round 3 were defects introduced by the previous round's repairs, not by the original draft. Each of those rounds converged only when the repair REMOVED a claim: a two-altitude source-plus-rendered check design collapsed to rendered-only, a browser-gate visibility claim was withdrawn to a stated accepted gap, and a scalar route count became a committed route set. new-spec already names this rule -- when a reviewer keeps finding under-specification in the plan rather than defects in the spec, the plan is over-specified: reduce it, do not extend it. Treat a review round whose findings are majority prior-round-repair as the signal to cut, and mark every finding draft-origin or prior-round-repair so the ratio is visible. The follow-on slice was then drafted at 4 criteria and 3 tasks rather than 14 and 5.
